SELECT 
    step1.event_status,
    step1.avg_by_status,
    step1.avg_by_status - step2.overall_avg as difference
FROM (
    SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) as avg_by_status FROM budget GROUP BY event_status
) step1
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(amount - spent) as overall_avg FROM budget
) step2
WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL    -- the rows it returns are your answer to that question
